mechanism: In handle(), the CFG_GET path for an unknown key logs a message and breaks without MsgReply/MsgError, so the client's MsgSend() stays REPLY-blocked on the server forever (name_attach channels have _NTO_CHF_UNBLOCK, so signals do not unblock it either). Fix: MsgError(rcvid, ENOENT) on that path, as the CFG_SET path does.
